## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Status:** Ongoing (unresolved as of end of captured logs, 03:59:27Z)

**Root cause:** dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation"), deployed 02:12–02:14Z. The new pool config stops connections from being released back to the pool — `in_use` pins at 20/20 (pool size 20) and `waiting` climbs monotonically (13 → 74+) with no drain, matching a connection leak rather than a traffic spike.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14 02:14:14Z (first `WARN pool acquire slow`), first hard failure 02:14:18.972Z:
```
ERROR access req-07401 /v1/cart -> billing-svc 503 659ms
ERROR pool   req-07401 ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting 13)
```
Still active at the last log line, 03:59:27Z — 1h45m and counting. Every `ERROR` in gateway.log (530+) is the same `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` cause, hitting all four downstream services (billing/orders/catalog/accounts-svc) roughly evenly. `/health` checks kept returning 200 throughout, so the gateway process itself stayed up — only the connection pool is starved.

**Scope:** Gateway only. Cross-checked worker.log for the same window — 0 real errors, DB pool stats flat at `in_use=1 idle=7 waiting=0` the entire time, jobs completing normally. Not a shared DB or infra issue.

**Rollback target:** dep-4471 (gateway). No other deploy is a candidate — dep-4470 (worker) finished over an hour before onset; dep-4472 (billing-svc) shipped 02:41, after the 503s were already underway.
